ABOUT BIP CAPITAL 
 BIP Capital is an integrated private market investment platform built to create and capture opportunities through BIP Ventures traditional venture anchor funds, an Evergreen equity BDC, and private credit offerings. With a distinctive multi-stage, multi-sector investment approach and a growing array of capital offerings, BIP Capital has generated consistent top quartile returns since 2009. 
 WORKING ON BIP CAPITAL’S CLIENT SUCCESS TEAM 
 We hire intelligent and driven individuals who value teamwork and trust, extending this mentality to positively impact investors and advisory firms, in a constant search for excellence. The Client Success team is the connective tissue between BIP Capital and the investors and advisory firms who trust us with their capital. Our clients — whether high-net-worth individuals navigating their first alternative investment or seasoned RIAs managing complex multi-vehicle allocations — expect a level of responsiveness and care that matches the quality of our investment platform. This team exists to deliver that. 
 We are relentlessly client-first. That means meeting investors and advisors where they are: answering questions quickly, anticipating friction before it becomes a problem, and treating every interaction as an opportunity to reinforce confidence in BIP Capital. 
 This is not a passive support function. The team operates at the intersection of fund operations, investor relations, and advisor enablement, requiring equal parts technical fluency and interpersonal skills. We move fast, we solve problems, and we hold ourselves to a high standard — because our clients do too.
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 We are seeking a full-time Client Success Analyst to join our team. This is a true entry-level opportunity and an apprenticeship-style role built for someone at the very start of their career who has a genuine interest in finance and private markets. You will work directly with the Senior Analyst and Senior Manager, supporting Level 1 investor inquiries, capital call and close tracking, account maintenance transactions, and reconciliations, and escalating more complex matters as you build your fluency in our platforms and processes.
 You will not be expected to manage investor relationships independently on day one. You will be expected to show up curious, execute well on the tasks in front of you, and learn quickly, taking on real ownership as your knowledge of fund operations and investor relations grows.
 This role offers a unique opportunity to build meaningful relationships with investors and advisors while developing hands-on expertise in fund operations, investor onboarding, and capital transactions. You will operate in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment and contribute directly to BIP Capital's ability to deliver a top-tier investor experience.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 The role requires a mix of interpersonal and analytical skills. As a Client Success Analyst, you will support the Client Success team across three core areas:
 Capital Calls & Closes 
 • Track capital call and close status for various investment vehicles; conduct investor follow-up and escalate to Senior Analyst or Senior Manager as needed.
• Review subscription documents and supporting documentation for completeness and accuracy.
• Perform close reconciliations, flag variances, and work with third parties to resolve discrepancies; escalate to Senior Analyst as needed.
• Support operational coverage during peak capital cycles or team absences.
 Account Maintenance & Investor Inquiries 
 • Serve as the primary contact for Level 1 investor inquiries, resolving issues and routing escalations to the Senior Analyst or Senior Manager.
• Process account maintenance transactions including transfers, distribution instruction updates, and demographic changes.
• Assist with investor documentation requests and ensure accurate maintenance of investor records in internal systems.
 Entity Creation & Operational Support 
 • Support new entity creation in coordination with legal and compliance, including review of subscription packages and PPM documentation.
• Assist with custodian onboarding for new entities and facilitate capital call processing.
• Identify and support process improvements that enhance investor experience and operational efficiency.
• Provide general operational support including supporting investor events, data integrity projects, and other team initiatives.
 Requirements 
 Education and Experience 
 • BS or BA required, preferably in finance, business, economics, or a related field.
• Recent graduates who have completed internships or coursework that demonstrate a genuine interest in finance and financial operations.
 • Internship, co-op, or academic project experience in financial services, venture capital, alternative asset management, or a related field is strongly preferred.
 Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities 
 • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
• Results-oriented with strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
• Exceptional time management and multitasking abilities, with the capability to prioritize across multiple concurrent workflows in a fast-paced environment.
• Demonstrated ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment, working both independently and collaboratively within a dynamic team.
• AI-forward mindset with the ability to leverage AI tools to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and enhance the client and investor experience.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); familiarity with CRM or investor management systems is a plus.
 Traits of Success 
 • Drive to succeed complemented by empathy, curiosity, and humbleness.
• Self-starter with strong work ethic and uncompromising personal integrity.
• Effective, versatile, and action-oriented when it comes to problem-solving.
 SUCCESS METRICS 
 • At 90 Days: Develop proficiency in BIP Capital's investor platforms, fund structures, and internal workflows. Demonstrate the ability to accurately process investor transactions and handle Level 1 inquiries with minimal guidance.
• At Six Months: Own assigned investor inquiries independently, meeting capital call and close SLAs. Achieve a low error rate on transactions, entity setups, and account maintenance; handle routine inquiry resolution without escalation.
• At One Year: Fully integrate into the Client Success team, taking ownership of all Client Success Analyst responsibilities across the investor portfolio. Contribute to process improvements and operational initiatives that enhance investor experience and team efficiency.
 Benefits 
 WHY JOIN BIP CAPITAL 
 • Opportunity to play a core role in supporting a regulated investment platform.
• We foster critical thinking and promote professional development from day one. 
• A collaborative culture that values innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
• Competitive compensation and benefits.
 If you have a passion for private markets and client success, we invite you to embark on a journey with a team committed to high performance, innovation, and collaboration. Join us and build your future with confidence.
 For more information about BIP Capital, please visit www.bipcapital.com. 
 BIP Capital is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, pregnancy, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics. BIP Capital is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

About Alumni Ventures 

 Alumni Ventures is one of the world’s most active venture capital platforms, with $1.4B+ in assets raised and investments in 1,600+ companies. Our network of 850,000+ members and 40+ dedicated investors connects accredited individuals to high-quality venture deals—typically reserved for institutions—through our alumni-driven communities and diversified co-investment strategy. With offices in Boston, New York, Chicago, Menlo Park, Manchester, NH, London and Tokyo we’re rapidly growing and committed to fueling entrepreneurial success while developing the next generation of VC professionals. 

 We believe our best work happens when we’re together. AV operates as a 5-day-a-week, in-office culture because collaboration, mentorship, and shared momentum matter. 

 About This Role 

 As an Associate Community Manager at Alumni Ventures, you'll play a vital role in supporting our investor community while gaining hands-on exposure to venture capital, startup investing, investor relations, and fund operations. 

 This role sits at the intersection of customer success, relationship management, investor communications, and financial services. You'll work closely with prospective and existing investors, Managing Partners, Community Managers, and cross-functional teams to support fundraising initiatives, investor engagement activities, and operational processes. 

 You'll help individuals navigate their journey with Alumni Ventures—from initial interest through investment and ongoing engagement—while developing expertise in client service, investor relations, venture capital, and business operations. 

 This is an ideal opportunity for professionals who are eager to learn, take ownership, and grow their careers in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. Through hands-on training, mentorship, and direct exposure to senior leadership, you'll build valuable skills in communication, relationship management, project management, operations, and venture investing. 

 While prior venture capital experience is not required, successful candidates are often interested in investing, entrepreneurship, startups, financial markets, or business strategy and are excited to learn about the venture capital ecosystem. 

 What You'll Do 

 Investor & Community Support 

• Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for prospective and existing investors. 

• Respond to investor questions through email, phone, webinars, events, and other communication channels. 

• Provide timely, accurate, and thoughtful support using approved resources and internal playbooks. 

• Help individuals navigate Alumni Ventures' offerings, processes, and community experience. 

 Investor Support and Community Operations 

• Build strong relationships with investors, community members, and internal stakeholders. 

• Deliver a high-touch, service-oriented customer experience across the investor journey. 

• Anticipate needs, identify issues, and help resolve questions with professionalism and empathy. 

• Support investor onboarding and ongoing engagement efforts. 

 Partner Support & Operations 

• Collaborate closely with Managing Partners, Community Managers, and senior leaders. 

• Support fundraising initiatives, fund operations, club programs, and syndication activities. 

• Assist with virtual events, investor meetings, webinar preparation, and follow-up activities. 

• Help ensure smooth execution of key investor engagement and operational processes. 

 Data, Reporting & Process Improvement 

• Track engagement activity, investor interactions, and key business metrics. 

• Help maintain clean and accurate data in HubSpot and other internal systems. 

• Support reporting for Community Managers, Partners, and leadership. 

• Identify opportunities to improve workflows, communication, and the overall investor experience. 

 Strategic Projects 

• Participate in special projects and cross-functional initiatives. 

• Support research, process improvements, pilot programs, and team priorities. 

• Take on increasing ownership as your knowledge and experience grow. 

 Who You Are 

 We're looking for a client-centered, detail-oriented professional who is excited to grow in a collaborative, team-oriented environment. 

 Required Qualifications 

• 1+ years of experience in customer success, client services, relationship management, account management, hospitality, recruiting, operations, financial services, consulting, or another customer-facing environment. 

• Effective written and verbal communication skills. 

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through consistently. 

• Demonstrated ability to build positive relationships and provide thoughtful support to customers, or other stakeholders. 

• Ability to learn and effectively use new systems, tools, and business processes. 

• Interest in learning about investing, venture capital, financial markets, startups, or related business topics. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

• Experience using HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar CRM platforms. 

• Experience supporting clients, customers, members, investors, advisors, or other external stakeholders. 

• Exposure to financial services, investing, venture capital, wealth management, banking, consulting, or related industries. 

• Experience coordinating projects, events, webinars, or operational workflows. 

 A Note to Candidates 

 We recognize that talent comes from many backgrounds. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you'd be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply—even if your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed above. 

 Our Culture & How We Work at AV 
 Regardless of title, this is what great looks like at AV. 

• Put team and stakeholders first. We win together and measure success by the value we create for our investors, founders, and each other. 

• Take extreme ownership and bias toward action. We act like owners, move with urgency, and follow through. 

• Debate rigorously and commit fully. We welcome diverse views, use data and sound judgment, and once aligned, execute as one team. 

• Focus on what matters most. We prioritize impact, simplify where possible, and channel energy where we have a real advantage. 

• Be AI-forward and tech-optimistic. We actively use AI and emerging technologies to work smarter, make better decisions, and amplify human judgment — not replace it. 

• Stay curious and think big.  We are continuous learners, aim high and build for long-term impact. 

 Benefits & Perks 
 We offer a flexible, employee-first benefits program designed to support your health, financial well-being, and life outside of work. Benefits begin shortly after hire and are designed to give you choice and flexibility based on your needs. 

• Comprehensive health coverage with multiple plan options, including employer-funded deductible support and HSA contributions 

• Dental and vision plans with multiple coverage tiers 

• Tax-advantaged accounts including HSA, FSA, and commuter benefits (with monthly employer contribution) 

• 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting 

• Company-paid life and disability insurance , plus optional supplemental coverage 

• Additional support programs including EAP, health advocacy, and wellness resources 

• Flexible, unlimited PTO and generous paid parental leave 

• 11 company holidays 

 Compensation 

 Compensation includes base salary plus equity and corporate bonus. 
 Privacy Policy   

 All employment is subject to passing a background check. Alumni Ventures is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.
